title: Cheque Imaging Service Unavailability — Delayed Clearing Cycle

content.summary: The cheque imaging service became unavailable on 2024-08-12 due to object storage quota exhaustion, delaying the morning clearing cycle by 3 hours and affecting 4,200 cheques with a total value of GBP 18.7 M.

timeline.event: Morning cheque clearing cycle begins; cheque-imaging-service starts uploading to object storage
Object storage quota exceeded (100 GB limit); uploads fail
cheque-imaging-service enters degraded state; image-clearing-gateway queues backlogged
P2 declared; storage team identifies expired cheque images not purged
Storage purge of images older than 90 days completes; quota freed
Clearing cycle resumed; all 4,200 cheques processed

content.root_cause: A lifecycle policy that automatically purged cheque images older than 90 days was disabled 45 days prior when it incorrectly deleted a batch of images under a legal hold. The policy was not re-enabled after the legal hold investigation completed, leading to gradual storage accumulation until quota was exhausted.
contributing_factors: Lifecycle policy re-enablement not tracked as a formal task after legal hold investigation
No storage usage alert configured below the 100% threshold
Image-clearing-gateway had no fallback processing path for storage unavailability

immediate: Manually purge cheque images older than 90 days (excluding legal hold items)
Re-enable lifecycle policy with legal-hold exemption filter
short_term: Add storage usage alert at 75 % and 90 % thresholds (JIRA OPS-2250)
Implement formal legal-hold policy with automatic re-enable tracking (JIRA LEGAL-88)
Increase object storage quota from 100 GB to 500 GB (JIRA INFRA-340)
long_term: Migrate cheque imaging to auto-scaling object storage tier
Implement image-clearing-gateway graceful degradation with local buffer
